label.responsibilities:
Develop, test, and maintain backend services and components of the RTB bidding engine.
Implement new features and improve existing functionality under senior engineers' guidance.
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-tested code.
Investigate bugs, troubleshoot technical issues, and help improve system reliability.
Contribute to performance optimization to improve the bidding engine's latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
Integrate with external advertising platforms and internal services through APIs and messaging systems.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering best practices.
Collaborate with team members to deliver features and improvements on time.
Learn and apply new technologies, tools, and techniques to improve software quality and development productivity.
label.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or final-year student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proficiency in at least one programming language, with Go preferred.
Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, and fundamental programming concepts.
Basic understanding of programming concepts, software design principles, computer networks, HTTP, and client-server communication.
Familiarity with Git and basic software development workflows.
Ability to write readable code, test implementations, and debug problems systematically.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills, willingness to learn and accept feedback, and ability to collaborate effectively.
Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.
